name: Health, energy and gold
summary: The player's health, energy and gold, and what happens at zero health: defeat, respawn and recovery from a fall out of the world.

extensionPoints.doc: what a dialogue or social action spends from energy/3

notes: Bars take their tone from vitalsView; do not pick colours in engine code.
Respawn health and the fall depth are parameters, not code.
